title: Tent Pegging
tagline: Gallop down the lane and lift the peg on the point of your lance.
description: Tent pegging (neza bazi) is the mounted lance sport of Pakistan and India. See the lane through the rider's eyes, slide to aim, let go to strike and time the ring onto the peg. Tournament Cup, endless Gallop Challenge, Practice, Learn drills, Think hints and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Tap Canter, Gallop or Full gallop to set off.
Slide your thumb left or right to steer the lance ring.
Let go as the ring reaches the peg to strike.
Lift the peg for 4 points; bonuses for perfect and full gallop.
Beat the rival's score over six runs to open the next round.
